mechanism_narrative: A persistent two-week decline in PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM signals broad withdrawal from discretionary out-of-home activity; because retail-and-recreation footfall is more discretionary than grocery, this withdrawal drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -3.6 to -42.4 between t-2w and t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is higher than over the last 28 days while PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both continue to decline or remain at their t-0w levels.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT stays below -45% for at least two consecutive weeks, it indicates durable avoidance of shared public spaces; this avoidance spills over into retail-and-recreation venues, keeping RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT <= -45% in two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: In weeks when TRANSIT is at or below -45% for two consecutive weeks, mean RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days exceeds its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of rising WORKPLACES (return to offices) and elevated RESIDENTIAL (continued home-based time) redistributes spending toward local neighborhood retail; because residential areas retain daytime population, RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -58.6 to -43.3 over three weeks while RESIDENTIAL stayed above +14
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days even though WORKPLACES continues to improve and RESIDENTIAL remains above +10.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, sharp PARKS declines precede declines in RETAIL_REC because parks mobility is an early indicator of caution and policy compliance; as restrictions tighten further, retail falls over the next week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS weekly mean falls by more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell from -3.6 to -33.7 between t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: Following a PARKS week-on-week drop greater than 10 points, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than its level in the prior 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: The seasonal post-holiday trough in retail-and-recreation is already visible in the last four weeks, and the calendar transition from mid-January to mid-February brings a modest seasonal rebound in discretionary shopping; RETAIL_REC therefore rises over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC fell from -42.0 at t-3w to -53.1 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below its last-28-day mean despite the calendar moving past the mid-January trough.

mechanism_narrative: Government work-from-home and capacity restrictions keep both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES deeply negative; when those series stay below -40% for two consecutive weeks, retail-and-recreation demand remains suppressed over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT <= -40% AND WORKPLACES <= -40% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: When TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are both at or below -40% for two consecutive weeks, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the prior 14 days.

mechanism_narrative: High RESIDENTIAL time combined with falling GROCERY_PHARM trips indicates home-confinement behavior; this behavior reduces retail-and-recreation excursions, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL = 14.7 and GROCERY_PHARM fell from -24.3 to -25.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL exceeds +14% and GROCERY_PHARM declines week-on-week, RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is higher than the prior 7-day level.

mechanism_narrative: A WORKPLACES recovery of more than 10 points over three weeks signals that commuting routines are returning; this restoration of weekday mobility lifts TRANSIT and then RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES improves by more than 10 points over three consecutive weekly means
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -58.6 at t-2w to -43.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: Following a WORKPLACES improvement of more than 10 points over three weeks, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days.
